steps.say: In Liar's Dice, everyone rolls five hidden dice that only they can see. On your turn, make a bid for how many dice of a certain face value are showing across all players.

Each bid must be higher than the last. You can bid more dice on the same face, or the same number of dice on a higher face (aces are highest). If you think the bid is a lie, you can call it instead of bidding.

When someone calls a lie, everyone reveals their dice. The actual count of the bid face is counted. If the bid was true, the caller loses a die. If false, the bidder loses one. Keep playing until only one player has dice left—that player wins!
